master.note: Leader line. Same fix as follower 1.2.11 in the shared receive path: the control UART (3 Mbaud, one interrupt per byte) stopped receiving for good after a single overrun, because the error callback never restarted reception -- the stream kept flowing while every command went unanswered. Reception is now restarted, and GET_UART_STATS reports rx_errors / rx_rearms. Verified on 0115m and 0116m (upgraded from 1.2.2): 15 min each of a 100 Hz encoder+IMU stream with a 100 Hz acknowledged command, ~87,000 commands, zero failures. AFTER FLASHING, unplug and replug the leader's USB cable.

slave.note: Model-dependent defaults now follow the motor model: auto-calibration stall torque (EL05 0.5 / RS00 1.8 N*m, was 0.35 for all -- too little to move an RS00, so calibration stopped short and could record the open direction backwards), default open direction (EL05 reverse, RS00 not), and a motion envelope enforced when none is stored (cont = stall rating, peak = t_max, temperature wall 90/100 C; was no limit at all). When the model record changes, 0x700B, the calibration torque and the direction are reset to the new model's defaults; a stored calibration torque still at the old 0.35 migrates on boot. A gripper OTA no longer refuses when the motor is not on the bus. Carries 1.2.11 (control-UART receive restarted after an overrun). AFTER FLASHING, unplug the 24 V power cable for ~2 s and plug it back; the USB cable can stay in.
